lore_clues.title: Contract Fragment
lore_clues.text: At least one claimant must be defeated. The copied version removes the words 'at least'.

lore_clues.title: Shipment Ledger
lore_clues.text: The Butcher enforced a contract operation designed by the Strategist. Your friend had already been named as a witness and participant.

lore_clues.title: Betrayal Dossier
lore_clues.text: Your friend knew the Ledger would claim you and deliberately arranged a controlled death.

lore_clues.title: The Original Clause
lore_clues.text: At least one claimant must be defeated - not exactly one. Defeating the Butcher and Strategist both fulfills the contract.

lore_clues.title: The Friend's Confession
lore_clues.text: He killed you to force a controlled crossing and keep the hidden force from claiming you. He hoped you would break the contract, but denied you the choice and acted from fear as well as care.
